svg.title: 396 of 500 random points fall inside the unit circle, so four times the ratio estimates pi as 3.168 — 0.026 out.
svg.desc: Five hundred random points in the square from minus one to one on both axes, with the unit circle drawn on top. Points inside the circle are filled discs; points outside are open crosses, so membership is readable without colour. 396 points are inside and 104 outside. The points fill the square evenly with no visible clustering or banding, which is what a usable generator looks like.
svg.text: Monte Carlo estimate of pi from 500 points (seed 4221)
